limitations: Static review only. No compiler/typecheck, build, signature check, application/UI/CI execution, runtime/report/raw/PNG or pixel analysis was performed in this review.

Inherited Driver try? report writing can silently fail; its CLI has no existing-output guard. The inspected root wrapper supplies the fresh absent-output-directory guard, which does not make all CLI failure reports reliable.
The hard watchdog _exit path bypasses normal defer/release observations; no universal failure cleanup guarantee is asserted.
Clearing helper references does not prove NSImage, CIContext internals or system image deallocation, nor a zero observer effect.

This single recipe combines a tone-map request with output RGBA8/sRGB conversion. Actual tone mapping, visible improvement, macOS14 visual equivalence, product suitability and coordinated-flight/lifecycle parity remain untested here.

scope: Independent static source/hash review of one local macOS13 actual-snapshot SDR recipe; no product change or runtime acceptance.

sdk_contract.create_cgimage: Public explicit output format/color-space API, deferred=false renders at this call; invalid/unsupported input can return nil.
sdk_contract.tone_map_option: Public Bool option available on macOS11; its documented effect is conditional on an HDR CGColorSpace. Extended values alone do not establish that condition. New helper correctly records actual application as unknown.
